inputs.coverage: A flattened ellipsoid using the 54×50×26 km semi-axes measured by Karkoschka (2003) from Voyager 2 observations. The standard gray grid marks unavailable surface imagery. Shared lighting describes the model shape; no craters or photographic detail are invented.
